payload.body: Crate CR-108 follow-up: current Frick boot/auth audit still shows no Rust BootSeams/AppDefinition first-sign-in lifecycle hook. App routes merge after framework auth and cannot shadow /auth/email/signup, /auth/apple/verify, /auth/google/verify, or /auth/oidc/:id/verify. Crate added a seeded web-smoke fixture to verify real browser restore/read/live-sync against the Rust host, but production first-session creation remains blocked on this FR-306 seam.
